business_summary: Hoden Seimitsu Kako Kenkyusho Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells electric discharge machining, industrial gas turbine parts, and other metal products. The company operates through Electric discharge Machining and Surface Treatment; Molds; and Machinery, equipment, and Others segments. It offers aircraft engine parts, servo press machines, fully chrome-free coating, dies and molding, and automotive parts. In addition, the company provides dies-molding, and extrusion dies for aluminum and ceramic honeycomb. Further it engages in surface treatment of aircraft engine components, gas turbine components, and automobile-related items, chromium-free coating; and creating mechatronics products, making, and manufacturing of related items, and commissioning of press composite processing system, digital servo press, and press parts. Hoden Seimitsu Kako Kenkyusho Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1961 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan.
